intro: Open ground is scarce in Kirari Suleman Nagar, one of the most crowded parts of north-west Delhi. When a school, a resident welfare association or a builder here sets aside space for children, it is usually a small plot boxed in by buildings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for sites like these at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away, and sends it to Delhi by road.

Small sites need careful planning more than big budgets. Send us the length and width of the plot, the age group of the children and a few photos, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Please also tell us how wide the approach lane is, because larger play systems are assembled on site. Our installation team or a dealer in the Delhi region then sets everything up, self-standing or grouted.

sections.h: Fitting a playground into a small Delhi plot
sections.html:
On a tight plot, choose pieces that give a lot of play per square foot. A compact multi play system such as Tiny Tot combines a slide, steps and a deck in one footprint, and two or three spring riders fill the corners for the youngest children. Leave the marked safe zone clear of walls, gates and parked scooters.

Delhi swings from hot, dusty summers to cold, foggy winters, so we use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic that handle both. For adults in the same colony, see our outdoor gym equipment in Kirari Suleman Nagar.

faq.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Kirari Suleman Nagar?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai, send it to Delhi by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in the region. Share photos of the approach lane so we can plan the delivery.

faq.q: What can we fit in a play area the size of a single plot?
faq.a: Usually a compact multi play system and a few spring riders or a see-saw. Send the exact measurements and we will mark the safe play area on a layout drawing before you approve anything.

faq.q: Will the equipment cope with Delhi's summer heat and winter fog?
faq.a: Galvanised steel resists rust through damp winter months, and roto-moulded plastic does not corrode. In summer, a shaded spot keeps slide surfaces comfortable for children in the afternoon.

intro: Kishanganj sits in the far north-east of Bihar, close to the West Bengal border and the tea country of north Bengal. It is one of the wettest parts of the state, and the long monsoon decides what kind of playground equipment will last here. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor play equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, and we send it about 1,710 km by road to schools, societies and public gardens in Kishanganj.

Most buyers in a town this size are schools and small housing societies setting up their first proper play area. We help you choose a few pieces that suit the age group and the ground, then send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and the quote, we manufacture, dispatch and install, either with our own team or through a dealer in eastern India.

sections.h: Materials that survive a long, wet monsoon
sections.html:
Months of rain and high humidity rust bare iron quickly, and painted mild steel starts flaking within a few seasons. Our frames are galvanised pipe, where a zinc coating protects the steel, and slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic that cannot rust at all. Both carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

Ground matters as much as material. Pick the highest, best-drained part of your campus, and lay rubber flooring under swings and slide exits so children are not landing in mud. Our swing sets and see-saws are a sensible first purchase for a school starting small.

faq.q: Can FunPlay send equipment as far as Kishanganj?
faq.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and transported by road. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, using grouting or a self-standing base.

faq.q: How do we stop the play area turning muddy in the rains?
faq.a: Raise the base slightly, give it a gentle slope for drainage and lay rubber flooring under the equipment. Rubber dries quickly after a shower and cushions falls better than wet soil.

faq.q: What should a school in Kishanganj buy first?
faq.a: A swing set, a see-saw and a slide cover the basic play needs of most primary classes. You can add a multi play system later, and we will plan space for it on the first layout.

intro: Very little flat land exists in Kohima. Schools, churches, colonies and offices in the Nagaland capital sit along ridges and slopes. A playground here usually has to be planned around a terrace or a cut in the hillside. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment at Vasai, near Mumbai, roughly 2,300 km away, and supplies sites across the north-east by road.

Because the distance is long, we spend more time on planning before anything is made. Send us photos of the site taken from a few angles, the measurements of the flat area you have and the age group of the children. We will suggest equipment that fits a terrace and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. Installation is handled by our team or a dealer in the region.

sections.h: Building a playground on a hillside site
sections.html:
On sloping ground, the play area must sit on a level, well-drained terrace with a retaining edge. Children must never run off a slide exit towards a drop, so we face slides into the site. The layout drawing shows the clear zone around each piece. Grouting into a concrete base suits most hill sites better than a self-standing installation.

Kohima is cool for much of the year and very wet from roughly May to September. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle rain and moss without rusting. Climbers give children plenty of activity on a small footprint, and you can compare options on our Nagaland page.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on a sloping site in Kohima?
faq.a: Yes, once you have a level terrace for the play area. We mark the safe zone on the layout drawing and usually recommend grouting the equipment into a concrete base on hill sites.

faq.q: Is it practical to order from Vasai for a site in Nagaland?
faq.a: It is. We send equipment across India by road and install it with our own team or a regional dealer. Good photos and accurate measurements at the start help avoid changes later.

faq.q: Which pieces suit a narrow terrace?
faq.a: Climbers, a single slide and spring riders take little width. A compact multi play system can also work if the terrace is deep enough for its safe play area.

intro: Kollam lies on the Kerala coast between the Arabian Sea and the Ashtamudi backwaters, with the cashew industry, fishing harbours and lakeside resorts all close together. For playground equipment, that means salt air, high humidity and two rainy seasons each year. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor play equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,230 km away, and delivers it to Kollam by road.

We supply schools, housing projects, churches and temples with community grounds, and backwater resorts that want a family play corner. Tell us what kind of site you have and how many children will use it at once. We will suggest equipment, send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and install it through our team or a dealer in south India once you approve.

sections.h: Looking after equipment in coastal Kollam
sections.html:
Kerala gets the south-west monsoon from June to September and more rain from the north-east monsoon in October and November. Near the sea, salt settles on every surface between showers. Galvanised pipe and roto-moulded plastic are the right materials here, since plastic cannot rust and zinc protects the steel underneath.

A little routine care adds years to any coastal installation. Rinse the equipment with fresh water every few weeks, check bolts after the monsoon and report any damage to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921. Lakeside resorts often pick a themed set such as Forestia, and you can read about adult fitness on our outdoor gym page for Kollam.

faq.q: Does salt air damage playground equipment in Kollam?
faq.a: It damages bare or painted iron quickly. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up far better, especially if you rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time.

faq.q: Can a backwater resort get a small play area for guests?
faq.a: Yes. Share the space you have and the ages of children who usually visit. We will suggest a compact set and show the safe play area on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Who installs FunPlay equipment in Kollam?
faq.a: Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. The equipment is manufactured in Vasai, sent by road and installed self-standing or grouted, depending on your ground.

intro: Korba is the power and coal centre of Chhattisgarh, and many of the families here live in townships run by power plants and mining companies. Those colonies need play areas that hundreds of children use every evening, maintained by an estate office rather than a parent committee. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for such sites at our Vasai factory, about 1,070 km away by road.

Township and company buyers usually need clear paperwork before a purchase is approved. We send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, an itemised quote and the warranty terms, so the proposal can go through your internal process. Once approved, we manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment with our team or a dealer in central India.

sections.h: Planning a play area for a Korba township
sections.html:
Township playgrounds take heavy, daily use, so spread the load. One larger structure from our Play Lands range draws the older children, while swings, see-saws and spring riders in a separate corner keep toddlers out of the busiest traffic. Fine coal dust and hot summers are a fact of life here, which is one reason we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts that wipe clean.

Write a simple maintenance routine into the estate office schedule: sweep the rubber flooring, check bolts and chains each month and log any damage. For walking tracks and adult fitness, see our outdoor gym equipment in Korba.

faq.q: Can you provide documents for a company or township purchase in Korba?
faq.a: Yes. We share a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, an itemised quote and our warranty terms. These usually cover what an estate or purchase department needs to review.

faq.q: How should we handle dust on the equipment?
faq.a: Wipe or hose down slides and decks regularly and sweep the flooring. Roto-moulded plastic and galvanised steel clean easily and do not hold dust the way rough paint does.

faq.q: What warranty does FunPlay give?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, for manufacturing defects under normal installation and maintenance.

intro: Kota is known across India for its coaching institutes, but it is also a city of families, schools and new residential colonies along the Chambal. Summers here are long and fierce, and that heat shapes how a playground should be planned. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 710 km from Kota, and sends it by road to sites across Rajasthan.

We work with schools, housing societies, builders and public gardens. You share the site size, the age group and photos, and we suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing. When you approve the layout and quote, we build the equipment, dispatch it and install it through our own team or a dealer in north India.

sections.html:
From April to June, slides and decks in full sun get too hot for children to use in the afternoon. Orientation helps more than anything else. Where possible, set slides so the sliding surface faces north or sits in the shadow of a building or tree, and plan a shade structure over toddler pieces.

Roto-moulded plastic stays cooler to the touch than bare metal, and lighter shades from our 15+ colour options absorb less heat than dark ones. Rubber flooring is better than paver blocks, which hold heat and are hard to fall on. Our 5 ft slides are a common choice for school grounds, and the Kota outdoor gym page covers adult fitness.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment in Kota?
faq.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai, send the equipment to Kota by road and install it with our team or a dealer in north India, either grouted or on a self-standing base.

faq.q: Which colours stay cooler in a Rajasthan summer?
faq.a: Lighter shades absorb less heat than dark ones. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colours, so you can pick light tones for slides and decks that face the sun.

faq.q: Can children use the playground in the afternoon in May?
faq.a: Only if it is shaded. Plan the layout so slides face away from the afternoon sun and add shade over younger children's pieces, or schedule outdoor play for the morning and evening.

intro: Kottayam has an unusually large number of schools, colleges and parish institutions for a town its size, and many of our enquiries from central Kerala come from them. These buyers want a playground that serves several classes on one ground, through heavy rain for much of the year. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, Maharashtra, and sends it about 1,160 km by road to Kottayam.

Institutions usually plan a playground once and expect it to last, so we start with the details. Tell us the number of children who play at once, their ages and the dimensions of the ground. We will propose a layout with the safe play area marked, then manufacture, dispatch and install the equipment through our team or a south Indian dealer.

sections.h: Zoning a school ground by age
sections.html:
A kindergarten child and a Class 6 student play very differently, and putting them on the same equipment causes most playground accidents we hear about. Divide the ground into zones. Spring riders, a toddler swing and a low slide go in one corner for ages 3 to 5. Older children get climbers, taller slides and a multi play system such as one from Castle Crest.

Kottayam's rain falls through both monsoons, so place each zone on raised, well-drained ground and lay rubber flooring beneath. Teachers on duty should be able to see every zone from one spot. Read about fitness equipment for staff and parents on our outdoor gym page for Kottayam.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground for a school with several age groups?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the ages and how many children play at a time. We divide the ground into zones and mark each safe play area on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Does FunPlay install equipment in Kottayam district?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: What material should a Kerala school choose?
faq.a: Galvanised steel frames and roto-moulded plastic parts. They handle constant humidity and two monsoons without rusting, and they carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

intro: Families in Kozhikode spend their evenings outdoors, along the beach promenade and in neighbourhood grounds, so public play spaces here see steady use. The city sits on the Malabar coast and takes the full force of the south-west monsoon each year. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 950 km north, and delivers it to Kozhikode by road.

Our buyers here include the municipal corporation's parks, schools, housing projects and hotels. Share the space, the age group and photos, and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. After you approve the layout and quote, we manufacture and dispatch it, and our team or a dealer installs it on site.

sections.h: Sand, salt and surfaces near the beach
sections.html:
Many seaside play areas sit directly on sand. Sand cushions falls when it is loose and deep, but it compacts after rain, hides litter and spreads into nearby walkways. Rubber flooring on a firm, drained base needs less upkeep and stays usable after a heavy shower.

Salt air is the other concern. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic slides last much longer than painted iron, and a fresh-water rinse every few weeks keeps salt from building up on joints. If you want something with a local feel, look at our Paper Boat from the Kagzi collection. Adult fitness is covered on our Kozhikode outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Is sand a good surface under playground equipment near the beach?
faq.a: Loose, deep sand cushions falls, but it compacts after rain and needs regular raking. Rubber flooring on a drained base usually needs less maintenance for a busy public space.

faq.q: Do you supply municipal parks in Kozhikode?
faq.a: Yes. We supply parks, schools, societies and hotels, with equipment made in Vasai and installed by our team or a regional dealer. We start with a layout drawing for approval.

faq.q: How often should coastal equipment be cleaned?
faq.a: A fresh-water rinse every few weeks and a check of bolts after the monsoon. Report any damage to our after-sales team so parts can be assessed under warranty.

intro: Kulti grew up around steel works and coal mines in the Asansol belt of West Bengal, and many of its neighbourhoods are older company colonies. Some still have play areas from decades ago, with rusted swings and broken concrete that are no longer safe. FunPlay Systems manufactures new outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, near Mumbai, and sends it about 1,520 km by road to the Asansol area.

If you are replacing an old playground, send us photos of what is there now, along with the size of the ground and the ages of the children who use it. We will suggest what to remove, what to install and where the safe play area should go. Installation is handled by our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

sections.html:
Before new equipment goes in, the old footings, broken slabs and protruding bolts must come out, because they become trip hazards inside the new safe zone. Hard, compacted ground in the mining belt usually suits grouted installation, with each post set in concrete.

Summers in this part of Bengal are hot and dry, with coal dust in the air, and the monsoon brings heavy rain from June. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts cope with both. For a colony ground, a mix of merry-go-rounds, swings and one larger structure gives every age something to do. Fitness options for adults are on our Kulti outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Can you replace an old, rusted playground in Kulti?
faq.a: Yes. Send photos of the existing equipment and the ground. We will suggest a new layout, and the old footings should be cleared before our team or dealer installs the new pieces.

faq.q: Which installation method suits hard ground?
faq.a: Grouting, where each post is set in concrete, is usually best on compacted or rocky soil. Self-standing installation suits sites where digging is not possible.

faq.q: How long is the warranty on new equipment?
faq.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects.

intro: Kumbakonam is a temple town in the Cauvery delta, and many of the institutions that run schools and community spaces here are trusts and religious bodies. They tend to buy carefully and expect equipment to last for many years in heat and seasonal floods. FunPlay Systems designs and builds outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,160 km away, and sends it to Tamil Nadu by road.

Elsewhere in the state, we have installed a resort playground in Dindigul, and we supply schools, trusts, societies and parks across the region. Send us your site size, the age group and a few photos. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, and install through our team or a dealer once you approve.

sections.html:
The delta is flat, and during the north-east monsoon from October to December water can stand on open ground for days. Do not place a playground in the lowest part of a compound. Raise the base slightly above the surrounding ground, slope it towards a drain and use rubber flooring, which dries far faster than soil.

You can see our Dindigul resort project for an example of our work in the state. For trusts and schools that want something with an Indian character, our Timeless Play structures draw on traditional games, and the Khel Khud collection is built around group play. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

faq.q: Do you supply playground equipment to temple trusts in Kumbakonam?
faq.a: Yes. We supply trusts, schools, societies and parks. Share your site details and we will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing before you approve a quote.

faq.q: How do we keep the play area usable in the rainy season?
faq.a: Raise the base slightly, slope it towards a drain and lay rubber flooring. Avoid the lowest corner of the compound, where water collects first.

faq.q: Do you have equipment based on Indian games?
faq.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals range includes Timeless Play and Khel Khud, designed by our own team with many pieces inspired by Indian games and nature.

intro: Kurnool stands on the Tungabhadra at the gateway to Rayalaseema, and it is hot and dry for most of the year. Schools, colonies and municipal parks here need playground equipment that copes with strong sun and dust rather than constant rain. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor play equipment at Vasai, Maharashtra, about 670 km from Kurnool, and delivers it by road.

A common question from Kurnool schools is how to serve both small children and older students without buying two playgrounds. We answer that on the layout drawing, which shows the equipment we suggest and the safe play area around each piece. Once you approve the layout and the quote, we build, dispatch and install through our team or a dealer in south India.

sections.html:
Most school playgrounds in Kurnool serve children from about 3 to 12 years old. Split the space into two clear areas with a walkway between them. The younger side needs low slides, spring riders and a toddler swing. The older side can take climbers, a taller slide and a larger structure from our Robo Romp or Clown Capade ranges.

In the summer months, plant or build shade on the younger side first, since small children play closer to the ground and surfaces heat up quickly. Rubber flooring stays cooler and safer underfoot than concrete or hard-packed earth, and it does not need watering like a lawn.

faq.q: Can one playground serve nursery and primary students in Kurnool?
faq.a: Yes, if you split the ground into a younger zone and an older zone with a walkway between them. We mark both on the layout drawing.

faq.q: How is the equipment delivered to Kurnool?
faq.a: It is manufactured at our Vasai factory and sent by road. Our installation team or a dealer in south India then installs it, grouted or self-standing.

faq.q: Which surface is best in hot, dry weather?
faq.a: Rubber flooring. It absorbs impact, stays cooler than concrete and does not turn to dust in the dry season the way bare earth does.

intro: Latur has built a reputation in Maharashtra for its schools and coaching classes, and education is where most of our enquiries from the city come from. A school playground in Latur has to serve many children in short breaks, on dry ground that bakes hard in summer. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 400 km away, and sends it to Marathwada by road.

Being in the same state helps with planning and dispatch. Closer to home, we installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. For your school, share the ground size, the number of children per break and photos, and we will send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Our team or a dealer installs everything once you approve.

sections.h: Designing for short, crowded school breaks
sections.html:
When several classes come out together, children crowd the first piece they reach. Spread the equipment so that the busiest items, usually slides and swings, are at opposite ends of the ground. A multi play system with several slides and climbing routes, such as one from our Play Lands range, lets many children play at once without queues.

Marathwada's black soil turns hard and cracked in the dry months, then soft after heavy rain. Grouting each post in concrete keeps the equipment stable through both. Lay rubber flooring under the busiest pieces, read about our Raymond project in Thane, and see our Latur outdoor gym page for staff and parents.

faq.q: What equipment suits a large school in Latur?
faq.a: A multi play system with several slides and climbing routes, plus swings and see-saws placed apart from it. This spreads children out during breaks and reduces queues.

faq.q: Do you install in Latur from your Vasai factory?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a dealer in Maharashtra. On hard Marathwada soil we usually recommend grouting.

faq.q: What details should a school send for a quote?
faq.a: The length and width of the ground, the age range, roughly how many children play at once, and a few photos. We use these to prepare a layout drawing and quote.
